mentions.name: racket-coding-agent
mentions.description: This is a personal AI coding agent, the author's fourth, written in Racket Scheme. It is hardwired to use deepseek-v4-flash-0731 via FireWorks.ai and supports only the tools the author needs. It is open-sourced to give others ideas rather than for general adoption.
mentions.audience: The author's own use; tailored to his personal needs
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on my fourth AI coding agent, this one written in Racket Scheme: https://github.com/mark-watson/racket-coding-agent
mentions.author: mark_l_watson
